lines.text: What happens when you start GTA 6?
lines.say: What happens when you start G.T.A. six?

lines.text: You land in Leonida. A made-up version of Florida.
Its heart is Vice City. Neon, beaches and chaos.
It's inspired by Miami. Just way more wild.
But that's just one of six regions.
The Leonida Keys. Tiny tropical islands.
Port Gellhorn. A forgotten beach town.
Ambrosia. Sugar mills and biker gangs.
And Mount Kalaga. Wild forests and trails.
You play as two people. Lucia and Jason.
A couple pulled into crime. Together.
For now, only on PS5 and Xbox. No PC yet.
lines.say: For now, only on P.S. five and Xbox. No P.C. yet.

lines.text: The strange part? The first trailer opens with Lucia in prison.
So the moment you start GTA 6…
lines.say: So the moment you start G.T.A. six…
